title: Shared types
description: Value types that several contracts reference by this exact version.

sha256.description: A lowercase SHA-256 digest in hexadecimal.

identifier.description: An operator-chosen name: lowercase, at most 64 characters, starting with a letter or digit.

contract-set.description: Structure and meaning fingerprints of every record and shared contract the writing install pins in a development data-root stamp, in ascending contract order; null only when written in the released stage.

items.description: The pins of one record or shared contract.

contract.description: Family and id of the contract, as the registry names it.

structure.description: Structure fingerprint of the contract's single development version.

meaning.description: Meaning fingerprint of the contract's single development version, descriptions included.
